subject: c-act
title: C.ACT.------POL.SIGN.
description: Chart on book p. 119 (AE(PD)-7). C-ACT (composite activism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; POL-SIGN (political significance) is the partner. From the subject: RE-ST (restructuralism), PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) and DEC (decentralization). GRAD (gradualism) is on a dotted line from the subject. From RE-ST: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PROG-SIGN: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) is on a dotted line from PHY-U-P. From EXP-DY: INFO-DS (information dissemination).
